item.title: Microsoft Defender Part 5: A Walk Through the Microsoft Defender Portal
item.description: The final post in the Microsoft Defender Demystified series. A friendly, hands-on walk through the Microsoft Defender portal at security.microsoft.com, every major section explained, where Microsoft Secure Score now lives, the unified Microsoft Sentinel experience, and a practical 'first hour' agenda any professional can follow today.
